request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --behaviour

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The test asserted that list(todos) with no options shows completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction makes hiding completed todos the default, so that assertion is now wrong. I changed only that call to list(todos, { includeDone: true }), which keeps what it checks (showing everything when asked). The includeDone: false assertion is unchanged.

approvals.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
